done_when: Close's review and plan reads do not wait for an agent place, and a test run limited to a few named test files does not wait for the test place

findings.body: Raise: Functional — The new admission check grants a free run based on the count from `fasttest.related`, but that function counts only files named `test_*.py` or `*_test.py` (`fasttest.py:276–279`). For an existing client with `test = "pytest tests/acceptance.py tests"`, changing five conventional test files admits the picker without a test place, while its underlying command also runs the explicitly named `acceptance.py`. `fasttest.py:57–86` leaves that operand in the command. The added doctest check does not cover this case, so the run can exceed the five-file limit while the test place is occupied.
findings.title: Explicit nonstandard pytest files bypass the test place

stop.reason: Owner chose narrow: small test runs skip the test queue only when the test command has no doctest option; reviews and plan reads still skip the agent queue

why: A 2-minute review waits about 10 minutes for an agent place and a worker's small test run queues for the single test place
